verdict.line: You lose if you melee-trade into an up Q (Decisive Strike) before level 3; you win from level 3 on by poking with Q (Obliterate) plus W (Siphon of Destruction) and finishing with R (Realm of Death) once he's isolated.

brief.thesis: Garen has zero ranged pressure and no gap closer beyond walking and his Q speed boost, while Morde's Q+W combo out-ranges everything he owns. The whole lane is about denying Garen the one window he has — his empowered Q silence into E (Judgment) spin — and punishing every cooldown he's forced to burn just closing distance.

theirWindow.when: Q up and you're in melee range
theirWindow.what: He can silence you, get free tenacity and an empowered auto, then spin E on top of it. Do not stand in auto range while his Q is available — back off and poke instead.

yourWindow.when: Q down or he's walked up to farm
yourWindow.what: Freely land Q (Obliterate, refreshed off passive stacks from prior autos) and W (Siphon of Destruction) — he has no answer to ranged poke without Q's speed boost to close. From level 6, flash or walk in and drop R (Realm of Death) to isolate him for a duel he can't escape.

powerCurve.note: Garen's early all-in with E+Q hurts before your W
W online, poke him for free at range

start.why: Sustain through his E spin poke and mana for repeated Q/W trades

boots.why: Tenacity shortens his Q silence and helps you disengage his E stick attempts

core.why: Burn punishes him for walking up, scales your poke into shred
Omnivamp sustains you through spin trades, true damage ramps duels
Movespeed on takedown/ability lets you kite his approach and reposition off R

situational.when: he's building tank items and you need more burn
his AD scaling and true damage R are outpacing your effective HP
you'd rather cut his auto/E poke damage over needing tenacity

runes.keystoneWhy: Three spell hits (Q, W, auto) trigger free movespeed, letting you poke and immediately kite out of his E/Q engage range

summoners.why: Flash lets you close the gap for R when he tries to walk away from your poke; Teleport keeps your wave-clear-heavy lane from losing tempo

playing.title: Never melee-trade with Q up
playing.detail: If his Decisive Strike is available, stay outside auto range — take the trade with Q/W only.

playing.title: Poke every wave, all lane
playing.detail: Land Q (Obliterate) whenever the passive stacks are ready and layer W (Siphon of Destruction) on top; he cannot answer this at range.

playing.title: Isolate before you commit R
playing.detail: Realm of Death only fully pays off when the fight is 1v1 — walk him away from minions/jungle before dropping it, not mid-wave.

playing.title: Track his HP for his R threat
playing.detail: Demacian Justice is true damage scaling off your missing health — don't sit below ~40% HP in his E range even if you're winning the trade.

playing.title: Punish his all-in windows
playing.detail: If he spins E into you without Q up, that's a cooldown he can't get back — full combo him back immediately, he has no shield left (W/Courage) to answer a second rotation.

playing.title: Use E for repositioning, not just shield
playing.detail: Veil of Berserker's movespeed is what actually keeps you out of his E range after you poke — don't hoard it purely as a damage shield.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Liandry's/Riftmaker/Cosmic Drive Mordekaiser build and Phase Rush keystone as of my training data (early-to-mid 2026 patches); verify names and stats haven't been renamed or reworked on the current patch before finalizing the build.
